regime_context: Hong Kong thematic leadership is narrow (only 4 of 17 themes eligible under the trend gate) with Energy (H-shares) leading and Banks challenging at a modest 0.157 margin. Momentum rank is a focus lens only; the single validated edge here is drawdown/shake-out control via the absolute-trend gate, which is functional (gate_helps true). Track record is strong on direction (46 calls, 96% dir accuracy) but all subjects are unscorable except two tech names, so grading leverage is limited.
emerging_watch: Watch the margin between Energy and Banks: a CONFIRMED leadership handoff to Banks would require Banks to not only close the 0.157 score gap but also for Energy's durability_bar to fall below 0.5 or for its breadth to drop under 0.4 while Banks holds above 0.55 — until then Energy remains leader and no handoff is confirmed.
